Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

yspecx 0.1.0

  • (feat) df_to_yspec(): Convert a data frame to a yspec specification file
  • (fix) df_to_yspec(): Stop on duplicate variable names instead of silently keeping the last row, and accept .yml output paths.
  • (feat) ysx_check(): Also runs ysx_check_repeats(), forwarding error_on_fail. Groups must be unique by default; set dots: {pre_grp_count: <n>} on group columns to require n rows, or pre_grp_count: ~ (null) to skip the check. Data columns and specification variables must match in both directions: a mismatch raises an error, or is reported with error_on_fail = FALSE.
  • (feat) ysx_check_missing(): New exported missing-value check. Missing values are now disallowed by default; allow them per column with dots: {na_ok: true} (replaces anymissing). Every data column must be in the specification (an error unless error_on_fail = FALSE), optionally after merging a second specification (spec2). The specification may describe more columns than the data has.
  • (feat) ysx_check_repeats(): Raise an error when any group defined by the specification’s group: true columns does not have exactly count rows (default 1), unless error_on_fail = FALSE, in which case problems are returned. Use groups to define the groups in the same call, like group_by() then counting rows and checking that none has n != count.
  • (feat) ysx_load_pkpdspec(): Load the bundled pkpdspec.yaml specification of standard NONMEM columns (ID, TIME, DV, CMT, EVID, AMT, …).
  • (feat) ysx_ungroup(): Remove all group settings from a specification, so no column defines groups.
  • (feat) ysx_regroup(): Remove all existing group settings from a specification and mark new group columns.
  • (feat) ysx_plt_relab(): Relabel plot axes, legend titles and facet strips from yspec, with custom variable and facet-level labels, plot-to-spec variable mappings, and validated long/short label selection.
  • (feat) ys_sort_spec_vars(): Order a loaded specification to match data frame columns while preserving metadata and unmatched specification variables.
  • (fix) ys_write(): Accept .yml output paths. Preserve coded-value labels and write reloadable metadata when saving loaded or sorted specifications.
  • (feat) ysx_factors(): Extend yspec factor conversion with per-variable dots$order settings of first (default) or biggest (decreasing frequency), retaining unused levels and specification order for ties. Warns when values that are not in the specification become NA.

Developed by Omar Elashkar.
